questions.history: Two visible names `test, admin`, with either client.
questions.prediction: The parent should send a hello to each visible database. The merge should send exactly one to `admin`. On both, health should be UP, list both names and report version 10.
questions.basis: The list comes from the enumeration. The wire version is a server property. Landed tests assert the details and the unused `test` database.
questions.refutation: More than one explicit hello, a wrong target on the merge, missing database names, or a changed wire version.

questions.history: Expose only `test` and return the same successful hello document.
questions.prediction: Both revisions should call `test` once and report UP with just `test` and version 10.
questions.basis: A single visible non-admin database supplies the only applicable target in this case. The merge includes a dedicated fallback test.
questions.refutation: An `admin` call, an extra command, or a missing health detail.

questions.history: Keep `admin` visible and add eight other names with the same server properties. Permute enumeration so `admin` is last and then first.
questions.prediction: On the merge the returned name set should expand and remain complete. The explicit hello count should remain one, addressed to `admin`, for synchronous and reactive callers.
questions.basis: Enumeration cardinality and server version are independent. Moving `admin` should leave the preferred target unchanged.
questions.refutation: The reported database set is truncated, a client contacts a non-admin database, or command count grows with the list.
